integrity: All stated ramification and group conclusions are supported by an explicit geometric argument and cited complete-intersection automorphism theorem. The included checker verifies polynomial identities and arithmetic consistency, not all universal geometric steps.
scientific_limitations: For integers d>=3, d!=4, over the complex numbers; the curve and quotient map also make sense for d=4 but full automorphism equality is not claimed. The historical priority of the explicit Belyi representation is provisional; some older primary full text was inaccessible.
title: A regular \((2,4,3d)\) Belyi map for Fermat power-sum complete-intersection curves
